subtitle.simple: How a small permissions change took down millions of websites.
subtitle.tech: ClickHouse permissions change → duplicated bot feature file → panic in the FL2 proxy.

headline.simple: Problem: On November 18, millions of websites show only error pages. Why?
headline.tech: Bug: Proxy FL2 panics on an oversized bot feature file (HTTP 5xx).

text.simple: A visitor opens a website, and the request first reaches Cloudflare's bouncer.
text.tech: An HTTP request hits the Cloudflare FL2 proxy.

text.simple: The bouncer uses its list of traits to check that a human is asking, then fetches the page.
text.tech: The bot module scores the request with 60 features, then forwards to the origin and returns 200 OK.

text.simple: On November 18, the database team changes the access rights to make queries safer.
text.tech: 11:05 UTC: Access to the r0 tables in ClickHouse is granted explicitly.

text.simple: With the new rights, the database lists every trait twice, once from each copy.
text.tech: After the GRANT, system.columns returns columns from default and also from r0.

text.simple: As every five minutes, the list builder makes a fresh trait list for the bouncers.
text.tech: The feature generator starts its run, as it does every five minutes.

text.simple: The list builder asks the database for all traits and gets each one twice.
text.tech: The query does not filter by database name and keeps the duplicate rows.

text.simple: It sends the overlong list to every bouncer around the world.
text.tech: The feature file with more than 200 entries is pushed across the whole network.

text.simple: The bouncer only has room for 200 traits, the list does not fit, and it crashes.
text.tech: The hard limit of 200 features is exceeded, and unwrap() on an error triggers a panic.

text.simple: The next visitor no longer gets through and sees only an error page.
text.tech: Every request through FL2 ends with HTTP 5xx.

headline.simple: Solution: The bouncer checks every new list and keeps the old one if something is wrong.
headline.tech: Fix: Validate generated config files like user input; fall back to the last good file instead of panicking.

text.simple: A visitor opens a website, and the request first reaches Cloudflare's bouncer.
text.tech: An HTTP request hits the Cloudflare FL2 proxy.

text.simple: The bouncer uses its list of traits to check that a human is asking, then fetches the page.
text.tech: The bot module scores the request with 60 features, then forwards to the origin and returns 200 OK.

text.simple: Stress test: The database team changes the access rights again, just like on November 18.
text.tech: The same permissions change on the r0 tables in ClickHouse as during the outage.

text.simple: With the new rights, the database lists every trait twice, once from each copy.
text.tech: After the GRANT, system.columns returns columns from default and also from r0.

text.simple: As every five minutes, the list builder makes a fresh trait list for the bouncers.
text.tech: The feature generator starts its run, as it does every five minutes.

text.simple: The list builder asks the database for all traits and gets each one twice.
text.tech: The query does not filter by database name and keeps the duplicate rows.

text.simple: It again sends the overlong list to every bouncer around the world.
text.tech: The feature file with more than 200 entries is pushed across the whole network.

text.simple: New: The bouncer checks every new list before using it and rejects the overlong one.
text.tech: The file is validated on load; an error no longer causes a panic.

text.simple: The bouncer keeps working with the old list and reports the error; the database team fixes the query calmly.
text.tech: Fallback to the last valid feature file, alert to the team, and the query gets a database filter.

text.simple: The next visitor is checked as usual and gets the page.
text.tech: Requests keep running with the 60 known features, 200 OK.

text.simple: Result: The website stays online even though the list was broken.
text.tech: Result: no outage despite a faulty config file.
